description: Search ApplyBolt's live pool of open jobs and internships. Use for any job hunt: software engineering, data, product, finance, marketing, nursing, sales — any role — plus internships, new-grad, remote, and H-1B visa-sponsorship jobs. Put the role/keywords in 'query' (it matches the job title and company and supports boolean operators). Returns fresh postings, each linking to its ApplyBolt job page to apply.

company.description: Employer name when the user wants jobs AT a specific company, e.g. 'Stripe'. Returns every open role there (all spellings, e.g. 'Stripe, Inc.'). Combine with 'query' to narrow, e.g. company 'Google' + query 'product manager'. One company per call.

limit.description: Max results to return (1-50). Defaults to 15.

location.description: City, state, or country, e.g. 'New York', 'California'. Omit for remote/anywhere.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.

postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs posted within this many days (1-30). Defaults to 30.

query.description: Boolean keyword search over job TITLE and COMPANY. Put the role here, e.g. 'software engineer', 'nurse', 'Google'. Supports AND / OR / NOT, "quoted phrases", and parentheses, e.g. '(software OR backend) engineer NOT senior'. This is the main filter — prefer it for roles.

salaryMin.description: Minimum yearly salary in USD, e.g. 120000. Returns jobs whose pay range reaches at least this.

visaSponsorship.description: True to return only jobs that offer visa sponsorship (e.g. H-1B).

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs on ApplyBolt
